amendments_considered.what_changed: First Amendment (Aug 31, 2023): restated Total Indebtedness to exclude the Specified 2023 Intercompany Note; restated Cash Equivalents. No threshold change.

Second Amendment (Feb 9, 2024; redline conformed copy): added Covenant Suspension Period (Qualifying Act of Terrorism) carve-out to Section 8.12 and Substituted Borrower Group EBITDA proviso in the ratio definition; thresholds unchanged (6.00x / 5.50x).
Third Amendment (Oct 3, 2025; conformed copy): Section 8.12 schedule still 6.00x to 1/1/2024, 5.50x after; key definitions compared and unchanged vs Second Amendment.

draft_notes: Covenant is 'not permit ... greater than'; first test FQ ending 2021-12-31 per the section. 6.00x period runs 'to, but excluding, January 1, 2024' so last quarter-end test is 2023-12-31.
Numerator has no single defined term: it is Net Indebtedness PLUS 8.00x annual MGM Master Lease rent. numerator_label set to 'Net Indebtedness'; the rent leg is recorded on the ratio term.

Denominator: Borrower Group EBITDA 'excluding annual rent payments ... under the MGM Master Leases' (i.e. EBITDAR-like). Borrower Group EBITDA itself deducts Master Lease rent, the ratio adds it back.
Second/Third Amendment exhibits are redline conformed copies; doc_text merges stricken and inserted text (e.g. 'ratio of (ia\n)'). Quotes from them were chosen from clean spans only.
Covenant Suspension Period (Qualifying Act of Terrorism) is an optional event; ignored per guide. 'Indebtedness' and 'Cash Equivalents' not expanded further.
EBITDA and Interest Expense children are paraphrased line-item labels (not defined terms) except Net Income and Interest Expense.
A separate new Credit Agreement dated October 23, 2025 (SMBC agent, accession 0000789570-25-000073) exists; not reviewed here.
